subject: W7 credential/provider producer landed as PR #290; System pane now reads the machine
result: Wired the missing producer behind the System pane Credentials/Providers rows (the W7 defect with receipts in #282: disclose_credential_world/with_credential_world had no production call site, so the pane read not attempted on every real machine). Both halves already existed, so this was wiring of the same shape as W6. Added aikit_core::credential_world::credential_requirements_for_model_routes (pure derivation of the worlds credential needs from its resolved Model routes; one requirement per credential-requiring provider, keyed to the real bound binding_ref when recorded, provider-derived otherwise; NotRequired contributes nothing). Added Service::credential_world() in aikit-cli (joins the resolved catalogue against recorded bindings, observes the roster over the same OS secure store credential setup uses, composes via disclose_credential_world) plus a new PaletteBackend::credential_world() seam attached in project_world() with warn-on-failure, forwarded by V2SurfaceService. Nobody-looked stays distinct from looked-and-found-nothing on three levels. Verified against this machines real home+catalogue: pane now reads Providers 1 observed | provider:os-secure-store/macos-keychain and Credentials 0/51 resolved to a provider, fully observed. Tests: aikit-core derivation units, aikit-cli credential_world_wiring.rs (real home+catalogue+store, incl. bound-credential-selects and decorator-forward proofs), aikit-tui attach tests. Full cargo test -p aikit-core -p aikit-tui -p aikit-cli green; clippy clean. Supersedes the investigation note w7-credential-producer-has-a-source-2026-09-10 (that said Not started; now landed).
